name: Financial Problems
overview: Scripture teaches that God is attentive to the prayers of those in distress and provides for the needs of the righteous, assuring that they will not be forsaken or left begging (Psalms 4:1; 37:25). Trusting in the Lord as our shepherd means we shall not lack (Psalms 23:1), and honoring Him with our resources is a key principle for financial stewardship (Proverbs 3:9). Wisdom is shown in managing wealth prudently, preserving treasures rather than spending foolishly, and a godly legacy benefits future generations while the wealth of the unrighteous ultimately benefits the just (Proverbs 13:22; 21:20).
